Introduction

Zhong Xing, also known as Starry, is a Chinese singer and member of the Chinese boy group 1B1 (ONE BY ONE) under The Line Star Entertainment.

He was revealed as a contestant of the survival show, "Boys II Planet", on June 7, 2025 with the release of the show's third round of visual posters. His company confirmed that he was the trainee in the visual poster #1.
